note: These are semantic test hooks, not layout templates. Native input/select IDs and outputs must be real visible controls. Output data-values contains a JSON numeric array synchronized with the actual visual. Every input has an accessible label. Formula demos must be marked teaching examples.

attention.inputs: attn-q-0,attn-q-1,attn-q-2: range [-3,3] step 0.5 default [1,0,2]; attn-k-0-0 through attn-k-2-2: range [-3,3] step .5 default K=[[1,0,1],[0,1,-1],[-1,1,0]]; attn-v-0,attn-v-1,attn-v-2: range [-3,3] step .5 default [1,2,-1].
attention.outputs: attn-weights data-values=[w0,w1,w2] and visible exact-enough numeric labels; attn-output data-value=numeric weighted scalar output. Three visible bars use data-weight-index=0/1/2 and actual proportional height in a common 140px plot area; scaled scores and q dot k shown. Use stable softmax(qK^T/sqrt(3)), then w dot V. Show V as one-dimensional values, not a full language model.
attention.mask: attn-mask: checkbox default false; when true, mask key index 2 before softmax, so w2=0; state clearly a pedagogical one-query causal-mask example. attn-reset: resets all Q/K/V/mask controls and visuals.

heads: Head selection should show a genuinely different declared toy projection. Explain multiple heads, concatenation and output projection; do not claim synthetic heads represent learned grammar. Any output values must be actual computations or explicitly structural only.
position: pe-pos: number or range integer [0,99], default 0; pe-dim: number or range integer [0,63], default 0. pe-value data-value = PE(pos,dim) with d_model=64. pe-canvas actual heatmap x=position 0..99 and y=dimension 0..63. Pointer and touch click updates selection and visible value. A linked 1D plot shows the selected dimension over positions; explain low dim = higher frequency.
complexity: complexity-n range or number [10,1024] integer default 50; complexity-d select or number (256,512,1024) default 512; complexity-values data-values=[n*n*d,n*d*d,3*n*d*d]. Draw actual corresponding bars or curves with data-complexity-index=0/1/2. Mark as theoretical scaling proxies with suppressed constants, NOT timings or FLOP benchmark. Show sequential operations separately and clarify autoregressive inference is still sequential.
results: result-task select values ende/enfr; result-chart visible bars data-bleu=model value, data-model=model label. Source all values from immutable paperMindData.tables Table2 (training cost separate units); no null-as-zero. ablation-config select selects a genuine Table3 row id; ablation-result data-values=[BLEUdev,PPLdev] and visible labels plus dataset newstest2013 and parameter/config fields. Exactly one reported row at a time; no three independent sliders synthesizing an unreported experiment. Training data/details and parsing results also included with citations.
source_and_anchors: All ten original node IDs exist in the HTML. Every core claim section has at least one appropriate data-source button. Runtime handles citations/ask/concept, do not implement custom postMessage. Include at least one data-ask and a real data-concept entry supplied by evidence, if any. No quizzes.
